name: HCK Capital Group Berhad
summary: HCK Capital Group Berhad, an investment holding company, provides property development, investment, letting, management, sale, and trading services in Malaysia. It operates in three segments: Property Development, Platforms, and Others; Platforms; and Others segments. The company also provides value engineering, consultancy, development and technology services; and consultancy, development and technology services.
